client_id.label: MyAnimeList Client ID
client_id.description: Your MAL API client ID (from https://myanimelist.net/apiconfig). Sent as the X-MAL-CLIENT-ID header.

use_ssl_verification.label: Verify SSL certificates
use_ssl_verification.description: Verify TLS certificates when calling the MyAnimeList API. Disable only behind a self-hosted proxy with a self-signed certificate.
